subject.title: Add backup/restore utility for config, cron jobs, and session history

question: What exact first-party restore/import scope should OpenClaw own for #13616, and which cloud, scheduling, encryption, and sync pieces should stay in plugins or ClawHub?
rationale: The remaining work crosses destructive local state writes, credential/session handling, archive trust, cron/session merge semantics, and optional integration scope, so automation cannot safely choose the product/security boundary.

options.title: Scope native restore first
options.body: Define a minimal core restore/import lifecycle for OpenClaw-owned archives with safe extraction, dry-run validation, conflict/rollback rules, and explicit cron/session component semantics; leave cloud/scheduled sync to plugins unless a missing API is identified.

options.title: Move most scope to ClawHub
options.body: Close or narrow the core issue if maintainers decide community plugin/skill backup flows are sufficient and only docs or plugin APIs should remain in core.

options.title: Design full core backup platform
options.body: Accept a broader core design that includes cloud targets, encryption, scheduling, retention, and restore, with a larger security and compatibility review before implementation.

recommendation.title: Scope native restore first
recommendation.body: Define a minimal core restore/import lifecycle for OpenClaw-owned archives with safe extraction, dry-run validation, conflict/rollback rules, and explicit cron/session component semantics; leave cloud/scheduled sync to plugins unless a missing API is identified.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue already has maintainer-side routing and needs a product/security boundary decision spanning core backup and plugin/ClawHub scope.
